component.name: ER Save Manager
component.summary: Save file editor and manager for Elden Ring and Dark Souls

description.p: Save file editor, backup manager and corruption fixer for Elden Ring. Also edits Dark Souls Remastered, Dark Souls II: Scholar of the First Sin, Dark Souls III and Nightreign saves.

ul.li: Character, inventory, equipment and appearance editing
Copy, swap, export and import characters between saves
Save fixer for corrupted saves and checksum repair
World state, map and teleport editing
SteamID patcher for using saves from other accounts
